title: larix decidua
intro: Larix decidua, commonly known as the European larch, is a deciduous coniferous tree native to the mountainous regions of Central Europe and the Alps. The health benefits of Larix decidua include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Larix decidua include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as bronchitis and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Larix decidua include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been found to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
